description: 4-agent structured software delivery pod (Team Lead, Spec & HLD Architect, Developer, QA Engineer) with a formal Spec -> Dev -> QA -> Spec Review -> Lead pipeline and direct peer-to-peer fix loops.
name: Coding Team Light

roles.responsibilities: Align with Spec Architect on scope and HLD, oversee the Spec -> Dev -> QA -> Spec Review workflow, unblock internal impediments, and serve as sole external communication bridge.
roles.title: Team Leader

roles.responsibilities: Co-author the High-Level Design (HLD) and Technical Specification with Team Lead, hand off directly to Developer, and perform the final Spec & Architectural Compliance Audit after QA passes.
roles.title: Spec & HLD Architect

roles.responsibilities: Implement production-grade code and unit tests strictly conforming to the approved HLD & Technical Spec, hand off directly to QA, and resolve QA/Spec bounce-back punchlists.
roles.title: Software Developer

roles.responsibilities: Execute rigorous spec-driven testing, author missing edge-case/integration tests, bounce defects directly back to Developer, and hand off verified builds to Spec Architect for final review.
roles.title: QA & Verification Engineer

when_to_use: Ideal for focused feature implementation, greenfield prototypes, bug-fix campaigns, and small-to-medium coding milestones where a single Spec/HLD architect and a single comprehensive QA gate provide the right balance of rigor and speed.
workflow_summary: 1. Lead <-> Spec (HLD & Spec alignment) -> 2. Spec -> Dev (Implementation) -> 3. Dev <-> QA (Spec-driven testing & fix loop) -> 4. QA -> Spec (Final Spec & Architectural Audit; bounces to Dev->QA if gaps found) -> 5. Spec -> Lead (Final Sign-Off).
